snippet.title: The Melty Way – 2D Slime Puzzle Platformer | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist The Melty Way on Steam:
➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3990570/The_Melty_Way/

You move, you melt. Play as a brave size-shifting slime in this colorful precision puzzle-platformer, dashing through handcrafted puzzles and perilous traps on your journey in The Melty Way.

The Melty Way is a 2D pixel-art adventure where you shift between small, medium, and large sizes to solve puzzles, reach new paths, and survive dangerous traps.

🔹 Fluid slime physics and size-shifting mechanics
🔹 Tight, responsive platforming
🔹 Brain-teasing puzzles
🔹 Handcrafted levels across multiple environments
🔹 Original soundtrack matching each area
🔹 A simple, cozy narrative with friendly characters
